From EAW archives

Photographs from EAW archives
show that these included: in the
kitchen, a built-in refrigerator, a built-
in folding ironing board, a clothes
washer, which the brochure stated,
could also be used as a food mixer! (a
similar all-purpose machine was
installed at EAW HQ, Kensington in
1928), a wall-mounted radiant heater
over a fold-out breakfast table, along
with a cupboard for the storage of a
vacuum cleaner. In a spacious
bathroom there was an electric water
heater, heated towel rail, wall mounted
heater and a lighted mirror over the
wash basin.

press cuttings including a feature
published by Ideal Home magazine in
February 1936.
